title: fix(lint): warn on a stored computed field whose expression reads another record, the clock or the acting user (#32529, #32554)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DWoM33HyZ6og6yankS7G48B)_

Fixes #32529
Fixes #32554

Clause-②: yes (widening) — `@objectstack/lint` exports two new rule-id constants, `STORED_EXPRESSION_CROSS_RECORD_INPUT` and `STORED_EXPRESSION_VOLATILE_INPUT`, and the exported `ExprIssue` gains an optional `rule`.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: follow-up #32703 — skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md, skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md and skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md teach a stored field carrying a formula's `expression` and say nothing of a cross-record or a volatile input, both now warned; the hand-written docs half is in this diff (`content/docs/data-modeling/formulas.mdx`, `field-types.mdx`, `validation-rules.mdx`)

Replaces PR #32701 (patch round 2 on contract review 6836331831, resumed from `1215cab9` on this branch with `origin/main` merged).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:存储型计算字段(非 `formula`、带 `expression`)的表达式如果读了**关联记录**的值(如请假单读 `record.employee.daily_hours`,或标题读 `record.?owner_id.?name`),或读了 `today()` / `now()`、当前用户、`can()`,`os validate` / `os build` / `os lint` 和对象保存口现在都给出**警告**,并说明这个值只在本条记录写入时算一次。本轮按合同复审补了四处:修复命令写全为 `os migrate stored-expressions --object 对象 --field 字段 --changed --apply`(限定到这一个字段,否则会把全库读时钟的存储值一起重算到运行时刻;不带 `--apply` 只是试运行);`--strict` 会因这两条警告失败这件事写进了 changeset、`os explain` 和本正文;`Clause-②` 改为 `yes (widening)`(新增两个导出常量与 `ExprIssue.rule`);对象扩展新加的存储型计算字段暂不判,范围写明(#32875 承接)。第 3 轮另把 blueprint 字段 `expression` 的说明文字里「关联记录的值经 summary 获得」改为与警告一致的两条路(formula,或由关联对象上的 flow 写入的快照字段)。
- 为什么改:存储型字段只在本行写入时算一次;关联记录后来改了不会重算(实测应为 30 的值停在 40),读时钟或当前用户的值也停在写入那一刻,而作者面此前什么都不说。裁决 6816315099 允许「拒收或提示」;席位修订 6821360087 改为提示。
- 风险与回滚:构建与保存口不拒收任何原先通过的写法,只多两条警告;但**带 `--strict` 的运行(`os lint --strict`、`os validate --strict`)会因警告失败**,且 CLI 没有按规则关闭的开关。仓内第一方存量 0 处;仓外第一方 1 处:HotCRM `src/sales/objects/forecast.object.ts:152` 的 `display_title`,HotCRM CI 跑 `objectstack lint --strict`,下次升级平台时该步会红,由 objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2435 承接(放宽 strict 或改为 flow 写入的快照字段)。回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`packages/lint/src/stored-expression-inputs.ts`(两条判定与提示文案),`packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts`(`fieldDefs`:按注册表提供的字段与注入列判断关联),`.changeset/32529-stored-expression-inputs.md`(`--strict` 后果与声明行)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/stored-expression-inputs.test.ts src/runtime-gate.object-formula-writes.test.ts`,预期 2 个文件 30 个用例全过:请假单读 `record.employee.daily_hours`、未声明的 `record.owner_id.name` 各得一条警告,`ownership: 'none'` 的对象不报 `owner_id`,保存口只给提示没有 422。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Round 2 keeps round 1's design (contract review 6836331831: PASS, 0 must-fix) and discharges its four should-fixes and two nits; round 3 discharges delta review 6837689158's should-fix A, its two nits and one seat-authorized describe edit.

- **New member `packages/lint/src/stored-expression-inputs.ts`**, called from the field-formula pass (`judgeFieldFormula` in `validate-expressions.ts`) on every field that is not a `formula` and declares an `expression` — the engine's own test for a stored computed field (`planStoredExpressions`, `packages/objectql/src/engine-top-level.ts`). Both findings are **warnings** (the lane's revised call 6821360087): the build passes, and the object save door answers them as advisories, never a 422.
  - `stored-expression-cross-record-input` (#32529): a read through a reference field of the object **as the registry serves it** (`referenceTargetOf` through `analyzeRelationshipTraversals`; `record.a.b`, `record.?a.?b`, `record['a'].b`). The field index is the served body (`objectsAsServed`, object-extension fields folded in, a two-package tie left out), then the declared fields, then the injected columns (`injectedColumnDefsFor`: `owner_id`, `created_by`, `updated_by`), never shadowing a declared field. The reference itself and its `id` are not counted. The remedy names a `formula`, a snapshot field written by a flow on the related object, and `os migrate stored-expressions --object OBJECT --field FIELD --changed --apply` (the finding fills in both names) to repair drift.
  - `stored-expression-volatile-input` (#32554): `now()`, `today()`, `daysFromNow()`, `daysAgo()`; the acting user under `current_user`, `user`, `ctx.user`, `os.user` (index spellings included); `can()`, `hasCapability()`. Not counted: `os.org`, `label()`, a comprehension variable named like a root.
- **Rule ids.** `ExprIssue` gains an optional `rule`; the `validateStackExpressions` entry maps `i.rule ?? EXPRESSION_INVALID` (`authoring-rules.ts`). The two ids are exported from the barrel and explained in `os explain` (`rule-explanations.ts`).
- **Round 2, should-fix 1 (`--strict`).** The changeset's "print them and pass. Nothing that was accepted is refused." is replaced: no build and no save that passed before is refused, and a `--strict` run (`os lint --strict`, `os validate --strict`) fails on every warning, these two included, with no per-rule switch. Both `os explain` entries say the same. The risk line above says what that means for HotCRM's `display_title` (its CI runs `objectstack lint --strict`); HotCRM's carrier is objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2435; HotCRM is not edited here.
- **Round 2, should-fix 2 (`--apply`).** The finding message, the cross-record `os explain` entry, the member's docblock and the changeset spell the repair `os migrate stored-expressions --changed --apply` and say that without `--apply` the command is a dry run that writes nothing (`packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/stored-expressions.ts`: "Dry run by default (writes no row), `--apply` to write").
- **Round 2, should-fix 3 (`Clause-②`).** `Clause-②: yes (widening)` naming the three widened exports, in this body and the changeset, after `.changeset/30633-flow-input-declaration-lint.md`. Measured on the built declaration closure (`pnpm turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/lint...'`, then `packages/lint/dist/index.d.ts`): both constants are declared and in the export list, and `ExprIssue` carries `rule?: string` (`dist/index.d.ts:834`). The level stays `patch` (`Metadata-protocol: none`).
- **Round 2, should-fix 4 (extension-added expression).** Not widened here; the extent is stated in the changeset and in Acceptance notes below; carried by #32875.
- **Round 2, nits.** `validate-expressions.ts`: the `fieldDefs` docblock no longer sits between `judgeFieldFormula`'s docblock and the function, and the served body is read positionally (`typedObjects[objectPosition]`, a counter on the object loop; `objectsAsServed` answers positionally with `recordsOf(stack.objects)`) instead of a `find` per object, so the #5017 receiver scan's plumbing table loses `typedObjects` and gains nothing. The blueprint jsdoc over `FORMULA_STORAGE_RULE` and the last blueprint test's comment name both rule ids (comment-only; nothing published from `@objectstack/spec` moves).
- **Round 3, should-fix A (scoped repair).** An unscoped `os migrate stored-expressions --changed --apply` rewrites every stored computed value in the database that differs, and a clock-reading one always differs (`--changed`'s own description: it "recomputes to the current time"). The finding now prints `os migrate stored-expressions --object NAME --field NAME --changed --apply` with this object's and this field's names (the member takes `objectName` from the pass), and says why it is scoped; the cross-record `os explain` entry, the member docblock and the changeset spell `--object OBJECT --field FIELD` and say the same; the volatile `os explain` entry says `--changed --apply` recomputes such a value to the time of the run, so another field's repair is scoped with `--object` and `--field`. Both flags are the command's own on `main` (`object: Flags.string(... multiple)`, `field: Flags.string(... dependsOn: ['object'])`).
- **Round 3, nits.** The `fieldDefs` docblock sits on `fieldDefs` again (the `servedSelf` line comment and declaration moved above it); `stored-expression-inputs.ts`'s module docblock is re-wrapped at the block's width.
- **Round 3, seat-authorized describe edit.** `STORED_EXPRESSION_RULE` in `packages/spec/src/ai/solution-blueprint.zod.ts` (the blueprint field's `expression` describe, published) no longer names a `summary` as a route for a related record's value; it names a `formula` or a snapshot field written by a flow on the related object, as the finding does. Describe text only; `content/docs/references/ai/solution-blueprint.mdx` regenerated (`check:generated --fix`, `check:docs`), and the changeset gains `'@objectstack/spec': patch` with one bullet.
- **Docs.** One clause each in `content/docs/data-modeling/formulas.mdx`, `field-types.mdx` and `validation-rules.mdx` (unchanged this round).
- **File surface beyond round 0's claim** (unchanged this round): `authoring-rules.ts`, `index.ts`, `validate-expressions.test.ts`, the three `.mdx` sentences, `packages/core/src/security/second-object-read-exposure.pin.test.ts` (one CALLERS row, `not-a-served-read`).

## Tests

- `packages/lint/src/stored-expression-inputs.test.ts` (13 cases) and the #32529 / #32554 block of `packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.object-formula-writes.test.ts` (6 cases): unchanged this round; 30 cases across the two files pass.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.test.ts`: the #5017 plumbing table drops `typedObjects` (no longer a receiver).
- Ablation this round (`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, the suites import `src`): `const servedSelf = typedObjects[objectPosition];` → `typedObjects[objectPosition + 1]` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `122b388d` → `d3b6e335`) → 1 failed / 29 passed (`warns a hop through a reference an object extension adds`); restored, blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty. Round 1's ablations (both arms, the injected-column line, the served-body fold) stand on unchanged code.

## Acceptance notes

- **Exposure.** In this repository: 0 (round 1's measurement over every first-party config; no fixture or example changed this round). First-party outside: **1**, HotCRM `src/sales/objects/forecast.object.ts:152` `display_title`, a stored title reading `record.?owner_id.?name` on purpose (ruling #24981 A), warned through the `owner_id` it declares. HotCRM runs `objectstack lint --strict` (`ci.yml`, `code-quality.yml`), so its lint step fails on this warning at its next platform bump: the field moves to a snapshot written by a flow, or HotCRM relaxes its strict gate (there is no per-rule switch). That disposition is HotCRM's own card: objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2435.
- **Extent: an expression-bearing field an object extension ADDS is not judged.** `judgeFieldFormula` walks `fieldList`, the declared fields of the declared `objects`; no pass of the field walk reads `objectExtensions[].fields`, while the engine plans such a field like any other. A hop THROUGH a reference an extension adds is counted; the expression an extension contributes is not read by either rule. The gap is inherited from the whole field-formula pass (its errors skip those fields too); widening the walk is #32875. The changeset states the same extent.
- `packages/spec/src/data/aggregate-field-type-compatibility.ts`'s prescription ("a field of its return type with the same `expression`") is unchanged; an expression with a hop or a volatile input now gets the matching warning. Noted, not filed.
